summary.name: Kling AI
summary.one_liner: Kling AI is a web-based AI creative studio for generating videos, images, audio, digital avatars and effects from prompts and reference material.
use_cases: generate short videos from text prompts
apply artistic style transfer to footage
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Kling AI as a single workspace for creating AI videos, images, audio, avatars and effects. Its visible toolbox lists tools for digital humans, creative effects, lip sync, style transfer, quality enhancement, AI photo, text-to-sound-effects and video-to-sound-effects. A community feed of user-made works is also shown. The page text is mostly interface labels and does not give technical details about models, output limits or how generation works.
notable: Toolbox covering video, avatars, lip sync, style transfer, upscaling and sound effects in one workspace
Listed as freemium in the hanishrao/collective-ai-tools directory
caveats: Freemium pricing is taken from the directory listing; the page text itself does not state plan details or limits
Page text is mostly interface labels, so specific capabilities and output quality are not verified
